places.oneLiner: Hainanese chicken rice and Phnom Penh noodle soup in Redmond.

places.oneLiner: Achiote pork tacos and Santa Fe-style stacked enchiladas near Kirkland's Park Lane.

places.name: Paparepas

entries.blurb: Start with the Lil' Brgs, wagyu sliders with special sauce on sesame buns, then a steak. A DJ plays through dinner.

entries.pullQuote: Seasonal omakase from New York's Iki alumni, in Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Book the omakase: 15 to 18 seasonal courses at two seatings, reserved at least three days ahead. The regular menu covers sushi, tempura and wagyu.

entries.pullQuote: Handmade tagliatelle carbonara on Bellevue's Main Street.
entries.blurb: Order the tagliatelle carbonara or the pappardelle Bolognese, the two signature pastas. The fall menu adds pici cacio e pepe.

entries.pullQuote: Handmade-tortilla tacos and over 100 tequilas in Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Get the Baja sea bass taco, battered and fried with apple slaw, and a pork belly taco next to it. The tequila list runs past 100 bottles.

entries.pullQuote: Cajun blackened chicken and sticky Korean ribs in a big Lincoln Square room.
entries.blurb: Order the Cajun blackened chicken, the chain's long-running signature, and share the sticky Korean ribs. It's a big room that fits a mixed group.

entries.pullQuote: Steakhouse in the Bravern. The lunch service is currently closed.
entries.blurb: Steakhouse in the Bravern. The lunch service is currently closed.

entries.pullQuote: Fragrant duck with steamed buns and seven flavor beef at Wild Ginger Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Order the fragrant duck, twice cooked with Sichuan peppercorn and served with bao and plum sauce. Add the seven flavor beef.

entries.pullQuote: Bulgogi brioche sandwiches and tiramisu lattes at a calm downtown Bellevue cafe.
entries.blurb: Get the bulgogi sandwich on toasted brioche and a tiramisu latte. Save room for the ube mini cheesecake, made with purple sweet potato.

entries.pullQuote: The Bellevue Roll and jalapeño-lime sushi at Lincoln Square's loud Latin-accented sushi bar.
entries.blurb: Start with the Bellevue Roll, eel and shrimp under tobiko, then the Wicked Sensation with its jalapeño-lime glaze. Happy hour runs twice daily.

entries.pullQuote: A brewpub on Northeast District Way in the Spring District.
entries.blurb: A brewpub on Northeast District Way in the Spring District.

entries.pullQuote: A long-running sushi room just south of Main, off 102nd.
entries.blurb: A long-running sushi room just south of Main, off 102nd.

entries.pullQuote: A Brooklyn Bridge pie from Seattle's hometown pizza chain, on Bellevue's Main Street.
entries.blurb: Order the Brooklyn Bridge, with Cascioppo sausage, mushrooms, olives, peppers and onions. Pagliacci has made pizza in Seattle since 1979.

entries.pullQuote: Crispy garlic chicken and pad Thai at a family-style Thai spot on Main.
entries.blurb: Order the crispy garlic chicken and a plate of pad Thai to share. The room on Old Bellevue's Main Street suits an easy weeknight dinner.

entries.pullQuote: Paella mixta and patatas bravas at a Bellevue Square Spanish tapas bar.
entries.blurb: Order the paella mixta early, since it takes about 30 minutes, then patatas bravas and chorizo empanadas. There are more than 40 tapas.

entries.pullQuote: Tempura portobello fries and halibut tacos on a BAM Alley patio in Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Start with the portobello fries, the house's signature appetizer, then the seared halibut tacos. Happy hour runs daily from 2 to 5.

entries.pullQuote: Charbroiled bacon cheeseburgers and crackly onion rings on Main Street since 1989.
entries.blurb: Get the bacon cheeseburger on its huge sesame bun, with fry sauce and onion rings. Add a milkshake; the room hasn't changed much since 1989.

entries.pullQuote: Coffee roaster on 102nd Avenue Northeast in downtown Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Coffee roaster on 102nd Avenue Northeast in downtown Bellevue.

entries.pullQuote: The JOEY classic steak with crispy mashed potatoes at Bellevue Place.
entries.blurb: Order the classic steak, a prime sirloin with loaded crispy mashed potatoes, or the steak and sushi. It's a polished room with a patio.

entries.pullQuote: Conveyor-belt sushi and a prize capsule for every 15 plates near Wilburton.
entries.blurb: Grab plates off the belt or order on the touchscreen; every 15 plates earns a Bikkura Pon prize. It's a fun pick with kids.

entries.pullQuote: The 520 Burger and big hot wings at an Old Bellevue bar and grill.
entries.blurb: Order the 520 Burger, flame-grilled with Swiss or Tillamook cheddar on brioche. Add the hot wings in the house's secret sauce.

entries.pullQuote: Bartender's-choice cocktails in a dim speakeasy tucked into the W Bellevue.
entries.blurb: Name a spirit and let the bartender build you a drink; this bar is known for off-menu cocktails. The back room, Unrest, opens Thursday to Saturday.

entries.pullQuote: Brazilian churrasco on Bellevue Way, served rodizio style.
entries.blurb: Brazilian churrasco on Bellevue Way, served rodizio style.
